thread:
Alex (AE): NimbusBank wants a 6-week POC with EU-only processing for customer data. They asked for subprocessors by region, confirmation that inference + storage stay in EU, BYOK with HSM if possible, and a simple monthly delta for a small reserved pool. Need legal/ops help pls
Rina (SE): quick q — do they accept a global control-plane for auth/routing (no user payload) or do they require control-plane inside EU too?
Cal (NimbusBank): control-plane outside EU is okay provided no customer content leaves EU. We need clear guarantees about data-plane locality and a failover policy that never routes through non-EU regions. BYOK preferred; HSM desired.
Marco (Legal): we can provide subprocessors inventory + SOC2/ISO PDFs. If they insist on control-plane in-region we need to move to Private deployment track. Also need signature on DPA + subproc addendum.
Sofia (Infra): hosted = soft-affinity, not a hard lock. Dedicated can pin tenant to eu-central-1 or eu-west-1 with in-region KV cache and storage. BYOK + HSM provisioning ETA ~10 business days. Private = longer lead time.
Rina (SE): for engineers, example endpoints for EU pinned POC:
```
POST https://api-redwood.eu/v1/completions
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
Control plane (global metadata): https://control.redwood-inference.com — only routing/auth metadata flows there.
Alex (AE): Cal — headline delta for a small reserved pool (~60 sustained QPS)? Procurement asked for ballpark.
Rina (SE): ballpark single-region small reserved (4x A100 equiv) ~ +$10k-13k/mo above hosted. If they want dual-region strict failover it's higher (~+$18k-22k). Quantization + batching could cut token costs ~20-30%. I'll follow up with a quote.
Marco (Legal): I'll assemble subprocessors CSV with region flags and the DPA addendum. Will note which subprocessors have EU-resident infra.
sysbot: scheduled maintenance alert — eu-central-1 storage cluster firmware update 2025-05-12 02:30-03:00 UTC; no data-plane downtime expected.
Sofia (Infra): ops checklist we'll need from NimbusBank:
```
- Preferred EU region to pin (eu-central-1 or eu-west-1)
- Expected sustained QPS and peak
- BYOK: public key + KMS contact + rotation cadence
- Approved client IP ranges (for allowlist)
- Required certs/attestations (SOC2/ISO/PCI if applicable)
- POC start window and rollback plan
```
Cal (NimbusBank): procurement wants a one-pager with subprocessors + BYOK steps and timeline. Can you bundle that?
Alex (AE): yes — Marco and Sofia will drop the subproc CSV + BYOK one-pager and I'll send to NimbusBank.
Marco (Legal): sending subprocessors list + DPA template by EOD. If they require in-region control-plane we flag for Private and estimate lead time.
Rina (SE): security note — we can enable request-level PII masking and run an eval harness demonstrating no content leaves pinned region during the POC. I'll attach the tech appendix to the packet.
Cal (NimbusBank): perfect, thanks. We'll review and get back with KMS contacts and timeline. :thumbsup:
Alex (AE): thanks team — tagging for the deal room and next steps.
